import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Create the dataset
data = {
    'Person ID': [1, 2, 3, 4, 5],
    'Gender': ['Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male', 'Male'],
    'Age': [27, 28, 28, 28, 28],
    'Occupation': ['Software Engineer', 'Doctor', 'Doctor', 'Sales Representative', 'Sales Representative'],
    'Sleep Duration': [6.1, 6.2, 6.2, 5.9, 5.9],
    'Quality of Sleep': [6, 6, 6, 4, 4],
    'Physical Activity Level': [42, 60, 60, 30, 30],
    'Stress Level': [6, 8, 8, 8, 8],
    'BMI Category': ['Overweight', 'Normal', 'Normal', 'Obese', 'Obese'],
    'Blood Pressure': ['126/83', '125/80', '125/80', '140/90', '140/90'],
    'Heart Rate': [77, 75, 75, 85, 85],
    'Daily Steps': [4200, 10000, 10000, 3000, 3000],
    'Sleep Disorder': ['', '', '', 'Sleep Apnea', 'Sleep Apnea']
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Parse blood pressure into systolic and diastolic
df[['Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']] = df['Blood Pressure'].str.split('/', expand=True).astype(int)

# Set style
plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8-darkgrid')
sns.set_palette("husl")

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(18, 12))
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.98)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
ax1 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 1)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Sleep Duration', y='Quality of Sleep', 
                         hue='BMI Category', size='Physical Activity Level',
                         sizes=(50, 200), alpha=0.8, ax=ax1)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality by BMI Category')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)')
ax1.legend(title='BMI Category', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# 2. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Occupation
ax2 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 2)
bar_data = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Physical Activity Level': 'mean',
    'Daily Steps': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
x = np.arange(len(bar_data['Occupation']))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax2.bar(x - width/2, bar_data['Physical Activity Level'], width, 
                label='Physical Activity', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax2.bar(x + width/2, bar_data['Daily Steps']/100, width, 
                label='Daily Steps (÷100)', alpha=0.8)
ax2.set_title('Activity Levels by Occupation')
ax2.set_xlabel('Occupation')
ax2.set_ylabel('Activity Level / Daily Steps (÷100)')
ax2.set_xticks(x)
ax2.set_xticklabels(bar_data['Occupation'], rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.legend()

# 3. Stress Level distribution
ax3 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 3)
stress_counts = df['Stress Level'].value_counts().sort_index()
bars = ax3.bar(stress_counts.index.astype(str), stress_counts.values, 
               color=sns.color_palette("husl", len(stress_counts)))
ax3.set_title('Stress Level Distribution')
ax3.set_xlabel('Stress Level (1-10)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
for bar in bars:
    height = bar.get_height()
    ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.1,
             f'{int(height)}', ha='center', va='bottom')

# 4. Blood Pressure by BMI Category
ax4 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 4)
bp_data = df.groupby('BMI Category').agg({
    'Systolic BP': 'mean',
    'Diastolic BP': 'mean'
}).reset_index()
x = np.arange(len(bp_data['BMI Category']))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax4.bar(x - width/2, bp_data['Systolic BP'], width, 
                label='Systolic', alpha=0.8, color='#ff6b6b')
bars2 = ax4.bar(x + width/2, bp_data['Diastolic BP'], width, 
                label='Diastolic', alpha=0.8, color='#4ecdc4')
ax4.set_title('Blood Pressure by BMI Category')
ax4.set_xlabel('BMI Category')
ax4.set_ylabel('Blood Pressure (mmHg)')
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(bp_data['BMI Category'])
ax4.legend()
ax4.axhline(y=120, color='red', linestyle='--', alpha=0.3, label='Normal Systolic')
ax4.axhline(y=80, color='blue', linestyle='--', alpha=0.3, label='Normal Diastolic')

# 5. Correlation heatmap
ax5 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 5)
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps', 'Systolic BP', 'Diastolic BP']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(corr_matrix, dtype=bool))
heatmap = sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, mask=mask, annot=True, fmt='.2f', 
                      cmap='coolwarm', center=0, square=True, 
                      cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, ax=ax5)
ax5.set_title('Feature Correlation Heatmap')
plt.setp(ax5.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 6. Heart Rate vs Physical Activity
ax6 = plt.subplot(2, 3, 6)
scatter = sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Physical Activity Level', y='Heart Rate',
                         hue='Sleep Disorder', style='Occupation',
                         s=100, alpha=0.8, ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate vs Physical Activity')
ax6.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level')
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate (bpm)')
ax6.legend(title='Sleep Disorder/Occupation', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()
plt.subplots_adjust(top=0.92, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
